تختتموا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَتِمُوا (taḵtatimū) /tax.ta.ti.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# تُخْتَتَمُوا (tuḵtatamū) /tux.ta.ta.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
